```{r Models and Tables}

### Here we use Distress contagion and positive neutral contagion factor solution suggested by Murphy
### This is indicated in model naming with Alt

# Predicting empathy opportunities in daily life

mE_OppsAlt <- glmer(E_Opp ~ IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control=glmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
tab_model(mE_OppsAlt)


Table1Alt <- tab_model(mE_OppsAlt, show.est = T, title = "Trait Empathy Predictors of Empathy Opportunities", show.stat = T, dv.labels = "Empathy opportunity in last 15mins Y/N", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Perspective Taking (IRI)", "Empathic Concern (IRI)", "Personal Distress (IRI)", "Fantasy (IRI)", "Pos./Neut. Contagion (EI)", "Distress Contagion (EI)", "Empathy Selection Task", "Single Item Trait Empathy Scale", "Malleability of Empathy"), collapse.ci = TRUE, show.reflvl = T, show.std = TRUE)

# Empathy Y/N
mEAlt <- glmer(E ~ IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, family = binomial, control=glmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
summaryh(mEAlt)

# Interacting with discrete emotion
mEAltEmotion <- glmer(E ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) * what_emo_namedPainRef + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, family = binomial, control=glmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
summaryh(mEAltEmotion)

# Discrete emotion main effect
mEAltEmotionMain <- glmer(E ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) + what_emo_namedPainRef + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, family = binomial, control=glmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))

# Interacting with valence
mEAltValence <- glmer(E ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) * valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, family = binomial, control=glmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))

# Valence main effect
mEAltValenceMain <- glmer(E ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) + valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, family = binomial, control=glmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))

compare_performance(mEAlt, mEAltEmotion, mEAltEmotionMain, mEAltValence, mEAltValenceMain, ranked = F)

Table2Alt <- tab_model(mEAlt, show.est = T, title = "Trait Empathy Predictors of Empathy Given Opportunity", show.stat = T, dv.labels = "Empathy given opportunity Y/N",  pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Perspective Taking (IRI)", "Empathic Concern (IRI)", "Personal Distress (IRI)", "Fantasy (IRI)", "Pos./Neut. Contagion (EI)", "Distress Contagion (EI)", "Empathy Selection Task", "Single Item Trait Empathy Scale", "Malleability of Empathy"), collapse.ci = TRUE, show.reflvl = T)

# Extent of empathy
mExtentAlt <- lmer(ExtentAvg_score ~ IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df_Emo_Answered)
tab_model(mExtentAlt)

# Add valence
mExtentValenceMainAlt <- lmer(ExtentAvg_score ~ IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C + valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df_Emo_Answered)
tab_model(mExtentValenceMainAlt)
# Does valence moderate rlnship?
mExtentValenceAlt <- lmer(ExtentAvg_score ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) * valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df_Emo_Answered)
tab_model(mExtentValenceAlt)

# Swap for discrete emotion
mExtentEmoMainAlt <- lmer(ExtentAvg_score ~ IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C + what_emo_namedPainRef + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df_Emo_Answered)
tab_model(mExtentEmoMainAlt)

mExtentEmoAlt <- lmer(ExtentAvg_score ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) * what_emo_namedPainRef + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df_Emo_Answered)
tab_model(mExtentEmoAlt)

require(performance)

compare_performance(mExtentAlt, mExtentValenceMainAlt, mExtentValenceAlt, mExtentEmoMainAlt, mExtentEmoAlt, rank = F)


# Emo. Sharing
mES_combinedAlt <- lmer(ES_combined ~ IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df)

Table3Alt <- tab_model(mES_combinedAlt, show.est = T, title = "Trait Empathy Predictors of Emotion Sharing", show.stat = T, dv.labels = "Emotion sharing extent Not at all (0) to Very much (7)",  pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Perspective Taking (IRI)", "Empathic Concern (IRI)", "Personal Distress (IRI)", "Fantasy (IRI)", "Pos./Neut. Contagion (EI)", "Distress Contagion (EI)", "Empathy Selection Task", "Single Item Trait Empathy Scale", "Malleability of Empathy"), collapse.ci = TRUE, show.reflvl = T)


mES_combinedAltValence <- lmer(ES_combined ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) * valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))

mES_combinedAltValenceMain <- lmer(ES_combined ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) + valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))


# Getting more specific, look at discrete emotions
mES_combinedAltEmotion <- lmer(ES_combined ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) * what_emo_namedPainRef + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df_Emo_Answered, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))


mES_combinedAltEmotionMain <- lmer(ES_combined ~ (IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + EI_PNC_score_C + EI_DC_score_C + EST_score_C + SITES_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C) + what_emo_namedPainRef + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df_Emo_Answered, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))


# Compare performance of our different models to see which best explains ES in daily life.
compare_performance(mES_combinedAltEmotion, mES_combinedAltEmotionMain, mES_combinedAlt, mES_combinedAltValence, mES_combinedAltValenceMain, mES_combinedAlt, rank = F)
```


```{r Make a figure illustrating rates of experiencing empathy across emotions}
### Emp by emotion standard deviations
TempDf <- filter(df, what_emo_named == "Happiness")
EmpbyEmoDf$propEmpSD[1] <- na.omit(TempDf$E) %>% sd()/length(EmpbyEmoDf)

TempDf <- filter(df, what_emo_named == "Sadness")

EmpbyEmoDf$upper <- EmpbyEmoDf$propEmpathy + EmpbyEmoDf$propEmpSD
EmpbyEmoDf$lower <- EmpbyEmoDf$propEmpathy - EmpbyEmoDf$propEmpSD

EmpbyEmoDf$Emotions <- unlist(EmpbyEmoDf$Emotions)
EmpbyEmoDf <- EmpbyEmoDf[ , c(1, 2, 4, 5)]
names(EmpbyEmoDf) <- c("Emotions", "propEmpathy", "upper", "lower", "propEmpSE")


EmpbyEmoPlot <- ggplot(EmpbyEmoDf, mapping = aes(x = Emotions, y = propEmpathy, fill = Emotions)) + geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) + geom_errorbar(data = EmpbyEmoDf, mapping = aes(x = Emotions, ymin = lower, ymax= upper)) + ylab("Proportion Empathy Experienced") + xlab("Emotion Observed")
?ggsave()
ggsave(plot = EmpbyEmoPlot, filename = "Empathy for Different Emotions.png", dpi = 300)
```
